blogs.title: Why Bigger Context Windows Matter for Large Language Models
blogs.description: Explains the concept of a context window in LLMs, why most models are limited to a few thousand tokens, and how real‑world applications—like in‑context learning with many examples or long‑form document summarization—are bottlenecked by this limit. Sets the stage for why extending the window is a game‑changing research direction.

blogs.title: Rotary Positional Embeddings (RoPE) Demystified: The Backbone of LLM Position Sense
blogs.description: Breaks down how RoPE works under the hood, why positional information is crucial for Transformers, and what goes wrong when you simply add new token positions. Uses visual analogies and simple math to help readers grasp why naïve extensions create “catastrophic values.”

blogs.title: Beyond Linear Scaling: How Non‑Uniform Positional Interpolation Saves Tokens
blogs.description: Introduces the two key non‑uniformities uncovered by LongRoPE—varying importance across RoPE dimensions and across early token positions—and shows how tailoring interpolation per dimension and per token dramatically improves performance over traditional linear (PI) or uniform NTK methods.

blogs.title: Evolutionary Search Meets Language Modeling: Finding the Best RoPE Rescale Factors
blogs.description: Walks through LongRoPE’s clever evolutionary algorithm: how it builds an initial population from known baselines, enforces monotonic constraints inspired by NTK theory, and iteratively mutates/crosses candidates to minimize perplexity. The post uses an intuitive “survival of the fittest” metaphor to make the technical details approachable.

blogs.title: From 4K to 2 Million Tokens: The Progressive Extension Pipeline of LongRoPE
blogs.description: Details the step‑by‑step strategy that gets a pre‑trained LLaMA2 or Mistral model from its default 4K window up to an unprecedented 2048K tokens with just ~1 000 fine‑tuning steps. Highlights the three phases—search → limited fine‑tuning at 256K → second search—to illustrate how each stage builds on the previous one.

blogs.title: LongRoPE in Action: Real‑World Tasks That Finally Fit Within Millions of Tokens
blogs.description: Shows concrete downstream benefits—such as near‑perfect passkey retrieval from multi‑million‑token books, lower perplexity on long documents like PG19/Proof‑Pile, and competitive scores on standard benchmarks despite the huge context window. Emphasizes how ultra‑long context unlocks new applications while preserving short‑context capabilities.
